pull_request.title: Calorimeter: restore 1.8 mm Pb sampling in the compact LAr prototype
pull_request.head: codex/lar-compact-hadron-prototype
pull_request.body:
Restore **1.8 mm barrel Pb** after the user authorized a larger annulus. Sampling radii are **1772.8–2350 mm**, with1248periods,50.18° inclination and all11original normalized radial compartment boundaries retained. Initial single LAr gaps return to~1.2mm. Warm outer radius **2641.7 mm** stays inside the original2830mm envelope. Explicit walls/vacuum/bath/service budgets are retained;650mm endcap XML/materials and the strict2.6mm control remain unchanged.

**Matched10,000 electrons/12workers and full readback pass:**8,544,489positive canonical hits,14.1min wall,3.543GiB peakRSS,21.408GB ROOT; no trimming. Source/analysis frozen at ec8815821a6530bbb6c6133332a5369d795b59f3. Same10–80GeV,flateta−3…3/fullphi primaries and fixed FTFP_BERT/0.7mmcuts/5mmcap,ECAL-onlyB0.

**The barrel penalty is partly recovered.** Held-out widths using the same fixed five-fold eta-forward-gain/refit-bootstrap diagnostic:

| Population | Original | Dense2.6mm | Restored1.8mm |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Inclusive | 13.12% | 6.00% | 3.74% |
| Core barrel, abs(eta)<1.2 | 2.43% | 4.30% | 3.04% |
| Transition,1.2–1.5 | 40.62% | 3.92% | 3.74% |
| Broad endcap,1.5–3 | 3.09% | 7.36% | 4.22% |

Core-barrel restored−dense is **−1.260pp [−1.437,−1.104]**; restored−original remains **+0.609pp [+0.482,+0.727]**, pointwise95%. Raw barrel widths are3.52/6.56/4.74%. The new geometry improves the dense control but does not preserve the original core precision. Both paired comparisons retain allzeros/tails,1000shared whole-event bootstraps, energy/direction/transition controls and underlying distributions. The fixed calibration uses5000fold refits per geometry per comparison, no invalid gains, ideal trutheta and no true-energy application input; exploratory conditional inference, no new family search.

![Three-model held-out energy controls](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/cd705d51ee62188cb57e07b51e74a6a9de841181/docs/validation/lar-restored/figures/calibrated-three-model-energy-regions.png?raw=true)

![Ten eta/folded-phi controls](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/cd705d51ee62188cb57e07b51e74a6a9de841181/docs/validation/lar-restored/figures/calibrated-three-model-angular.png?raw=true)

Native component/union checks report0overlaps and minimum26.8001969samplingX0 over9088actual-period probes. Exact serial/12-thread24-event equality covers19065hits; both100-event step-policy pilots pass.45analysis plus3compact geometry tests pass. Separate SysArch, prospective PhysVal and final exact-revision PhysVal assessments found no material issues; the residual original-reference penalty remains explicit.

[Full results, raw distributions and SVG/PDF/PNG](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-compact-hadron-prototype/docs/validation/lar-restored/README.md) · [Reproduction and source hashes](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-compact-hadron-prototype/docs/validation/lar-restored/reproduce.md) · [Evaluated fold models and separate full-fit reuse table](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-compact-hadron-prototype/docs/validation/lar-restored/calibration-models.json)

The reusable restored model is geometry/material-bound and needs fresh validation before deployment.37figure groups retain111PNG/PDF/SVG assets; paired binwise statistics/covariance and compact receipts are committed. Full ROOT/events/XML/libraries/logs and duplicate overlayJSON remain local.

TASK-LAR-COMPACT-HADRON;DES026/032/033. **DRAFT / isolated PROTOTYPE**; maintained LAYOUT-002 and engineering approval states unchanged. The comparison is a geometry bundle, not isolated Pb causality; raw mixed-spectrum widths are not intrinsic reconstructed resolution. Cut convergence, digitization/pileup/radiation, actual ports/pressure/thermal/routing and multi-TeV containment remain open. Unique canonical token ownership, project validation, labels and PR interactions feed existing Pages after merge; the completed task-parent turns are now included in their original canonical owners; current baseline/gap coordination usage remains active and unknown.

Stack (2026-11-18): **#147 → #148 → #149 → #150 → #151**. #150 selects the restored LAr EM working baseline; #151 adds the separate conditional 400 mm-gap prototype. Merge bottom-up, retargeting the next PR to main after its base merges. Canonical session/interaction records retain exact closed-turn accounting once; engineering approval and the current active coordination turn remain separate.

LAR-COMPACT-CALOTECH-DESIGN; CaloTech; exact f3ece1d6a6816c8172dfa841d63e5424730e8228; read-only/owned files none; inputs docs/design/DES-026-tracker-solenoid-baseline.md, docs/design/DES-032-allegro-lar-barrel.md, docs/design/DES-033-allegro-lar-endcaps.md, tools/lar_calorimeter/barrel.json, tools/lar_calorimeter/barrel_geometry.py, tools/lar_calorimeter/endcaps.json, tools/lar_calorimeter/services.json, docs/validation/lar10k/protocol.md. Task: Derive feasible compact LAr ECAL around DES026 with real vacuum/bath/walls, enough sampling X0 for 14 TeV pp, retaining 50.18deg inclination and relative sampling radii. Provisionally preserve Rout/Rin and normalized compartment boundaries, never uniformly shrink physical plate/gap thickness. Calculate integer planes, lead thickness and gaps preserving sampling precision if feasible. Quantify X0 for barrel and coherent endcap and identify tradeoffs. Primary public LHC/FCC depth sources needed; distinguish 14TeV pp from FCC-hh and low-energy control scope. Propose a quantitative configuration BEFORE transport. Exact source read-only; standard-library calculation/import okay, no native runtime, source writes, event transport, installation, publication or further delegation. Deliverable: Quantitative candidate parameter options, formulas and X0 target rationale with source locators, constraints and remaining gates.

Task: Assess exact DES026 tracker+solenoid surfaces, reservations and clearances for a compact LAr prototype. Recommend smallest defensible warm bore/sampling front while retaining conservative vessel/wall, vacuum, bath and service budgets. Inspect endcap/HCAL/forward handovers and existing side/rear routing proposals. Do not silently shrink services or certify model wall equivalents as pressure-vessel qualification. User authorizes isolated prototype; maintained baseline unchanged. Read-only, no native runtime, writes, transport, installation, publication or further delegation. Deliverable: Exact baseline envelope numbers, proposed radial/axial ledger and service implications, source locators and explicit engineering unknowns.
